name: rpg-helper
description: Claude runs your tabletop RPG. Three D&D 5e (2014) skills over an Obsidian campaign vault: narrate-encounter puts Claude in the DM's chair while people play their characters, simulate-encounter fights a party against a monster set with nobody playing, to answer who would win, and dry-run-recap turns a finished dry run into a player-facing recap for a campaign site.
